memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chronic kidney disease stage 3b and rheumatoid arthritis. Evidence: serum creatinine 1.8 mg/dL, eGFR 38 mL/min/1.73m2, urine ACR 120 mg/g, hemoglobin 11.2 g/dL; ESR 28 mm/hr, CRP 6 mg/L, RF positive, anti-CCP 45 U/ml. Patient reports morning joint stiffness, mild dyspnea on exertion, no cough. Examination: bilateral basal crackles, tender swollen MCP and PIP joints, no deformities. BP 138/84, pulse 78.

memories.text: I’ve had more stiffness in my hands this morning, especially the right wrist, and I feel a bit short of breath when I walk to the market. My feet are a little swollen by evening.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chronic kidney disease stage 3b, rheumatoid arthritis stable. Spirometry: FEV1 2.10 L (78% predicted), FVC 2.55 L (80%), FEV1/FVC 0.82; change in FEV1 since last test +0.05 L. Asthma Control Test not applicable. Technique checked: correct. Smoking status: never. Patient reports improved dyspnea, mild joint pain. Examination: lungs clear, mild bilateral pedal edema, joints mildly tender, no active synovitis.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Refer to Nephrology for evaluation of progressive CKD (eGFR decline from 41 to 34 mL/min/1.73m2 over 6 months, rising creatinine). Patient on maximal tolerated RAS blockade and SGLT2 inhibitor, requires assessment for possible dialysis planning and further workup.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Nephrology opinion: CKD stage 4, continue current regimen, monitor electrolytes, consider erythropoietin if Hb falls <10 g/dL, prepare for possible renal replacement therapy within 12 months. No immediate need for dialysis.
